references.text: Jacob makes a vow to the Lord, illustrating the practice of making vows to God in the Old Testament.
General regulations concerning vows to the Lord and the importance of keeping them.
Jephthah makes a vow to the Lord, and his daughter is affected by this vow, illustrating the consequences of vows for family members.
Hannah makes a vow to the Lord while she is in her father's house, an example of a woman making a vow.
Exhortation to fulfill vows to God without delay, emphasizing the seriousness of making vows.
